📅 This week

Cook (one session, ~1 h 15): 4 × Creamy cajun chicken & potato bowl + 4 × Nashville hot honey chicken bowl = 8 meals (filter "This week"). Both use the oven, so roast the potatoes and the Nashville chicken together, then the cajun chicken.

Split: eat 2 bowls a day. That's 6 boxes in the fridge for days 1–3 (3 of each) and 2 in the freezer (1 of each) for day 4, defrosted in the fridge overnight. If you only eat 1 bowl a day, freeze 5.

Portions: weigh the RAW chicken (200 g each), potatoes (300 g) and dry rice (60 g) before cooking, then weigh the whole COOKED batch and divide by 4. Cooking losses vary, so dividing the cooked batch makes every box equal.

🧮 How the macros are calculated

Every ingredient's raw or as-sold weight is multiplied by its per-100 g label values and added up (open a recipe and tap "Macro breakdown"). Lidl's own label is used wherever one exists (taken from the pack via Open Food Facts, because lidl.co.uk doesn't list nutrition for its core range). Loose veg and spices use USDA FoodData Central. Carbs are UK-style (fibre counted separately). Accuracy is about ±5–10%: labels themselves carry tolerances, oil left on the tray isn't eaten, and the sauce reduces a little. That's fine for weekly tracking.

Sources per ingredient (per 100 g)

🍝 Fixing the creamy tomato pasta (next time)

  • Aim for ~250 g of finished sauce per portion (1 kg for 4): 1½ tins chopped tomatoes + 300 g passata (or a 400 g jar of tomato sauce) + 400 ml stock, reduced to ~1 kg, then 120 g light soft cheese stirred in. Last time was ~½ tin per portion, and the pasta drank most of it.
  • Boil the pasta 3 min under the packet time, drain it, and keep ~100 ml of the pasta water.
  • When you box it, it should look too wet, because pasta keeps absorbing liquid in the fridge. Loosen with the pasta water.
  • Reheat: add 2 tbsp water, cover, microwave 2 min, stir, then 1–2 min more.
  • The extra sauce adds only ~40–60 kcal a portion (tomato is light). The soft cheese is where the calories are.

⚠️ Food safety

  • Chicken to 75°C, or no pink and juices running clear. Mince browned through with no pink.
  • Cool within 1 hour, refrigerate, and eat within 3 days. Freeze the rest and defrost it in the fridge.
  • Reheat until piping hot. Reheat rice only once (Bacillus cereus).
